title: Calculated Field Stored as State (Inadvertent Data Duplication)
pattern: Storing a derived or computed value as a structural field alongside its primary independent parameters.
why_bad: It duplicates knowledge of state. A change to `start` or `end` requires a synchronized manual update to `length`. If forgotten, the internal invariants of the struct break, leading to silent state corruption.
detection: A struct containing a field whose value is purely derivable via a deterministic mathematical or logical computation of other fields within the same struct.
counterexample: Caching highly expensive computations where mutations are strictly encapsulated and keep the field updated under the hood (e.g., via interior mutability).
source: *The Pragmatic Programmer* (20th Anniversary Edition), Topic 9: "DRY—The Evils of Duplication", p. 202-203.
